mentions.h: 50 GLORIOUS YEARS ON THE BRIGHTON ROAD

mentions.note: died 1977; lived in Lincolnshire; walked several London to Brighton races in the 1930s
London to Brighton walker 1924-1935, best 9hrs.35mins.25secs. in 1929; won fifth prize in Club Christmas Draw 1963

share.d: Charlie Wattam in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1945–1992: 6 mentions in 6 issues and 2 race results.
